**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

No non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant exists anywhere in the Agreement. I checked Confidentiality (§ 10), Shared Resources (§ 13, including the personnel access and Employee NDA/Invention Agreement covenants), Miscellaneous (§ 14) and Exhibit D's "Personnel" clause, and ran targeted searches for "solicit", "hire", "induce", "recruit" and "employ or engage" — all negative. The only personnel-related covenants run against Commerce One and do not restrict Corio from soliciting or hiring. That satisfies the preferred element ("Customer has no non-solicitation restriction"), so we propose no redline.
